name: Nodo Clinic
description: A quiet documentary block theme for an adult ear, nose and throat practice: a pale grey-green paper ground, brown text, green headings and one olive mark, Hanken Grotesk over Onest. The home page opens on one full-bleed photograph with two white vertical paper strips holding the headline and a white information bar; it continues with the problem, complaints as ruled rows, an unframed photo walk, a 45-minute visit as one sentence, a corridor band, a text roster, stepped accounts, notes and the visit. Navigation collapses into an overlay menu below 960 px. Sample content in English with eleven inner pages and one article; other languages follow. Works without any plugin.
